name: Kamisato Ayaka
title: Frostflake Heron
description: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

skills.name: Kamisato Art: Kabuki
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a flurry of sword ki.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging enemies along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Kamisato Art: Hyouka
skills.description: Summons blooming ice to launch nearby opponents, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
skills.info: "Clouds shroud the moonlit night. Longing descends like a fog, filling the one detained with wanderlust."

skills.name: Kamisato Art: Senho
skills.description:
Alternate Sprint
Ayaka consumes Stamina and cloaks herself in a frozen fog that moves with her.

In Senho form, she moves swiftly upon water.
When she reappears, the following effects occur:
·Ayaka unleashes frigid energy to apply Cryo on nearby opponents.
·Coldness condenses around Ayaka's blade, infusing her attacks with Cryo for a brief period.
skills.info: "Feathers fleeting wet / the white heron treads water / a sight without flaw"

skills.name: Kamisato Art: Soumetsu
skills.description:
Summons forth a snowstorm with flawless poise, unleashing a Frostflake Seki no To that moves forward continuously.

Frostflake Seki no To
·A storm of whirling icy winds that slashes repeatedly at every enemy it touches, dealing Cryo DMG.
·The snowstorm explodes after its duration ends, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
skills.info: "The blizzard veils the heron's thoughts, pity heavy in its heart."

passives.name: Amatsumi Kunitsumi Sanctification
passives.description: After using Kamisato Art: Hyouka, Kamisato Ayaka's Normal and Charged Attacks deal 30% increased DMG for 6s.

passives.name: Kanten Senmyou Blessing
passives.description:
When the Cryo application at the end of Kamisato Art: Senho hits an opponent, Kamisato Ayaka gains the following effects:
·Restores 10 Stamina
·Gains 18% Cryo DMG Bonus for 10s.

passives.name: Fruits of Shinsa
passives.description: When Ayaka crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, she has a 10% chance to receive double the product.

constellations.name: Snowswept Sakura
constellations.description: When Kamisato Ayaka's Normal or Charged Attacks deal Cryo DMG to opponents, it has a 50% chance of decreasing the CD of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 0.3s. This effect can occur once every 0.1s.

constellations.name: Blizzard Blade Seki no To
constellations.description: When casting Kamisato Art: Soumetsu, unleashes 2 smaller additional Frostflake Seki no To, each dealing 20% of the original storm's DMG.

constellations.name: Frostbloom Kamifubuki
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Soumetsu by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Ebb and Flow
constellations.description: Opponents damaged by Kamisato Art: Soumetsu's Frostflake Seki no To will have their DEF decreased by 30% for 6s.

constellations.name: Blossom Cloud Irutsuki
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Dance of Suigetsu
constellations.description: Kamisato Ayaka gains Usurahi Butou every 10s, increasing her Charged Attack DMG by 298%. This buff will be cleared 0.5s after Ayaka's Charged ATK hits an opponent, after which the timer for this ability will restart.

outfits.name: Springbloom Missive
outfits.description: Ayaka's travel outfit. Its design is based on the Fontaine dresses depicted in light novel illustrations and seems to serve as a window into the lifestyle of proper ladies who live in that nation.

outfits.name: Flawless Radiance
outfits.description: Kamisato Ayaka's outfit. This kimono features an armor-coated skirt, displaying the nobility and resilience of the Shirasagi Himegimi.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: Master of Inazuma Kamisato Art Tachi Jutsu — Kamisato Ayaka, present!\nDelighted to make your acquaintance.

voices.title: Chat: Stability
voices.text: I only wish life could be as leisurely as this a little more often... How greedy of me.

voices.title: Chat: Sword
voices.text: A blade is like a tea-leaf. Only those who sample it many times can appreciate its true qualities.

voices.title: Chat: Zoning Out
voices.text: So this is a day in the life of the Traveler... Hehe, I'm learning more about you all the time.

voices.title: Chat: Famous Sword
voices.text: A blade embraces its duty as a jeweler cherishes their gems.

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: Come with me, let us find shelter from the rain.

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: Her Excellency... What is she trying to communicate?

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: "Snow that once adorned the world in silver, thaws to reveal the gleam of the fruit upon frost-laden branches." *sigh* How picturesque! Only some tea would make this setting more complete.

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: There's a pleasant breeze and glorious sunshine... So, where shall we go for a walk?

voices.title: When It's Windy
voices.text: Close your eyes and face the wind... It feels wonderful, doesn't it?

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Oh, good morning, Traveler. ...Whenever I see you in the morning, somehow, it makes me feel like... today is going to be a good day.

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Good afternoon. It is normal to feel drowsy after lunch, might I interest you in a game of Go to stimulate the mind?

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: Greetings. An auspicious breeze blows this evening. Tonight will be peaceful.

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: "Was it one's thoughts that drew him to my dreams? Had I known it a dream, one would not have awakened." Hehe, I love that poem.

voices.title: About Kamisato Ayaka: Yashiro Commission
voices.text: "Inazuma Shogunate, Yashiro Commission, Kamisato Clan." Widely known as one of the most distinguished clans in all of Inazuma, it is the branch of the Tri-Commission that manages ceremonial and cultural affairs. Since my parents passed, Brother and I assumed responsibility for all clan matters, big and small.

voices.title: About Kamisato Ayaka: Position
voices.text: Many look up to me as the Shirasagi Himegimi and as the daughter of the Kamisato Clan. But the object of their respect has everything to do with my position, and nothing at all to do with me, Ayaka. It makes me think that... maybe, there is only one person I know who is truly able to get close to me...

voices.title: About Kamisato Ayaka: Aspiration
voices.text: Today, as in the past, I aspire to be somebody whom everyone can trust. But what motivates me is no longer the responsibilities I shoulder, or the expectations of other people. Rather, it is the fact that you are this kind of person, too.

voices.title: About Us: Teahouse
voices.text: If you've got time, shall we take a walk to Komore Teahouse? To chat about the art of tea on a pleasant day like this seems like the sophisticated thing to do.

voices.title: About Us: Festivals
voices.text: If I ever have the chance, I would very much like to experience the festivities of another nation with you one day. Though, I will need some guidance on local customs and etiquette, and advice on what gifts to bring... Could I trouble you to give me some guidance?

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: Visions are a seal of approval for those who are most ambitious. As for my own ambitions, they shall remain private for now. It is nothing more than an insignificant dream.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: It is said that "the flavor of Zen is that of tea," and it is also said that "the power of Zen is that of the blade." One might then ask: What does that say about the relationship between tea and the blade?

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: Have you ever noticed the withering sakura tree in the city? For me, there is a beauty to the withering, it brings back fond memories of the spring. Most people don't agree — sakura trees that will never bloom again are removed. But when I look at a tree, all I want is to see it blossom again... just one more time...

voices.title: About Thoma
voices.text: Thoma is a dear friend. He always lifts my spirits with his sunny disposition. In a sense, I think of him as another brother, and as a full member of the Kamisato Clan.

voices.title: About Kujou Sara
voices.text: Kujou Sara of the Tenryou Commission is... not known to smile, and I have had my fair share of disputes with her. She is, however, a loyal servant to Inazuma, there is no question about that.

voices.title: About Shikanoin Heizou
voices.text: Mr. Shikanoin belongs to the Tenryou Commission, just like Miss Kujou. He is very... principled, sometimes even more determinedly so than Miss Kujou. The only thing is, when it comes to the question of which matters should be governed by his principles, I believe only Mr. Shikanoin himself knows the answer...

voices.title: About Sayu
voices.text: Ah, little Sayu. She hasn't been causing you any trouble lately, has she? Hehe, if you ever notice her slacking off, please let me know.

voices.title: About the Raiden Shogun: Guesswork
voices.text: The Almighty Shogun? It would be improper of me to comment, given that I am one of her subjects. All I will say is that... I think that Her Excellency must get lonely on the road to eternity.

voices.title: About the Raiden Shogun: Standpoint
voices.text: To witness the Musou no Hitotachi and live to tell the tale is quite a remarkable feat. Even though I recognize her as our true deity with the power to change Inazuma's fate at will, if there is conflict between the two of you, then... I shall choose to side with you.

voices.title: About Yae Miko
voices.text: I have always greatly enjoyed working with Guuji Yae. Organizing festival affairs generally takes a lot of effort and doesn't generate much income, but Guuji Yae's events always come off both elegant and profitable.

voices.title: About Kamisato Ayato
voices.text: As the head of the Kamisato Clan, brother always has a full schedule of places he needs to be. I do try my best to share his load, but there is no changing the pressure he is subjected to all year round, and the toll it takes upon him. *sigh* If you see him, remind him to take care of himself, for his sister's sake...

voices.title: About Yoimiya
voices.text: The Yashiro Commission and the shrine maidens are responsible for festival affairs, and Yoimiya, as a fireworks expert, knows how to create an atmosphere. So we have become well acquainted with her over the years.\nHmm? Public order and fire prevention? We factor these concerns in well in advance during the planning stage. To deny people the chance to see fireworks simply for these reasons would leave them feeling very disappointed.

voices.title: More About Kamisato Ayaka: I
voices.text: Your request is quite unusual for me. Since I see you as a friend, it would only be fair to be open and honest with you, but if this means sharing secrets of the Kamisato Clan... I would ask that you keep anything I tell you in strict confidence.

voices.title: More About Kamisato Ayaka: II
voices.text: The Kamisato Clan once suffered a major blow when we failed to protect a swordsmith of national significance. We were harassed by the Fatui, we lost many of our people, and we received a great deal of criticism. It all aged Father greatly, and severely damaged the Kamisato Clan's standing within the Shogunate. Brother has worked tirelessly to reverse the trend since he assumed leadership, but although our clan's position is now restored and the Yashiro Commission is unified once more, we still rely on Brother to make the decisions on all matters of any importance.

voices.title: More About Kamisato Ayaka: III
voices.text: The art of blade forging taught by the Shogun varies based on astrology, application, materials used, the furnace conditions, individual personalities, and elemental changes. These differences between smiths is what gave rise to the Raiden Gokaden. Swordsmiths capable of forging renowned blades are seen as spiritual personnel with sacred abilities, and as such they should be managed by the Yashiro Commission, which oversees all cultural, artistic, and ceremonial affairs. So naturally, the swordsmith's betrayal is the fault of ineffectual management by the Kamisato Clan.

voices.title: More About Kamisato Ayaka: IV
voices.text: My mother was the most incredible person. She was always so dignified and elegant, always smiling, no matter what situation she might be facing. She had so much to deal with in the clan on so many levels, but she took it all in stride — it was like nothing could ever faze her. Everything about her was perfect, and I say that without exaggerating. *sigh* But the moment she passed away, I realized... I couldn't hide behind my mother any longer. I wasn't little Ayaka any more.

voices.title: More About Kamisato Ayaka: V
voices.text: What I want to say next is perhaps not befitting of a member of the Inazuma Shogunate, Yashiro Commission, Kamisato Clan, but... unless I am mistaken, I trust that you will not take issue with this slight departure from convention on my part...\nThat is to say... I'm a little tired, may I rest my head on your shoulder? Just for a moment.

voices.title: Kamisato Ayaka's Hobbies
voices.text: I have great affection for the arts: music, song, poetry, shougi, and dancing. And you?

voices.title: Kamisato Ayaka's Troubles: Concerns
voices.text: Troubles? Well, I mean... that's life, isn't it? There will always be things that don't go one's way. But I do not wish to worry those around me on account of things that are my concern alone... so, it is best if I keep them to myself.

voices.title: Kamisato Ayaka's Troubles: Desires
voices.text: Openness is something I find very difficult. I constantly have to remind myself that as a lady of the Kamisato Clan, there are countless people watching and countless expectations to live up to. I must be a model of exemplary conduct at all times. But even so, shouldn't I still follow my dreams? Shouldn't I... share my true feelings with you?

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: I'm fascinated by food from overseas. Though I don't get to try it very often... So, if I had to choose something from Inazuma, then probably... Chazuke. But not when anybody else is watching... So I tell you that in confidence.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: Though I do not eschew animal fat and organs entirely, they are far from my first choice.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Mmm... Yes, I am truly fortunate...

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: Thank you for the opportunity to try this dish. I will always savor it.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: Hmm... It's a bit greasy for my taste.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Come with me! We're not going far away — I promise it won't delay you too much.\nI managed to find out when your birthday was well in advance, so I could prepare in good time. Hopefully this wasn't assuming too much, but I guessed you might prefer this to an expensive gift.\nIn honor of your birthday, please allow me to perform a fan dance for you.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: Thank you very much. It has been richly rewarding to learn from you so far, and I believe my skills with the blade can go even further still.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: Thank you for your guidance. With your assistance, I am gaining a more thorough understanding of my capabilities.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: I feel more competent now than ever before. I even have the time outside my work for the Yashiro Commission to try some new things. Would you like to try one of my home-made snacks? I just learned how to make them recently.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: "Though I cling to that which has given me the strength to hold on, the weight of letting go is ever-foreboding."\nMy apologies, it should be a happy occasion, and yet it is such a sad phrase that comes to mind. Our time together has been so pleasant that I am fearful of losing what I have gained. I'm sorry, I must compose myself.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Take flight.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: My apologies.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Whirling snow.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Embrace the ice.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Sakura swirl.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Kamisato Art: Soumetsu!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: Collecting rare and exquisite treasures... Yes, this seems suitably sophisticated.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: Hehe... Today is a lucky day.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: I shall treasure this good fortune.

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: I will not stand for this.

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: A worthy opponent...

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: We ought to end this!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Do not overdo it.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Take care!

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: Pardon my indiscretion...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Much remains... unfinished...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: I have dishonored... our clan...

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: So rude!

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: II
voices.text: Unthinkable...

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Kamisato Ayaka, present.

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: I await your instruction.

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: A pleasure to be working with you.
